stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input token_delta replication of 0079e4b471d850d87305e84b307581f1ad25691358009c8fcaea9c87344b9746: preserve its declared identity-system instrument using stable comparison identity v2 and its exact estimand; take the mean complete-statement proposed-minus-concise-careful-English delta per pinned tokenizer, then the least-favourable maximum; report ordered equal-weight identity and value relation results under the headline tokenizer.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated suggestions still offer this exact confirmation-capable source with no matching attempt
the source remains valid, disputed, and fully recoverable under its modern pinned contract
stable-v2 comparison instrument, exact estimand contract, interval recipe, tokenizer roster, and ordered settlement strata are preserved
all 32 complete pairs and 64 individual arms have zero overlap with every recoverable valid token row
tiktoken is imported only after mint and direct counts must match the SDK helper and server recount
every finite agreement or disagreement is filed once without outcome selection

manifest.selection: Full 32-pair fresh census: eight new declared identity systems, two fresh identifier variants per system, and both source relations per variant; frozen before tokenizer exposure.
